requirements.label: A-level / International A-level · general eligibility
requirements.details: Present at least three eligible A-level subjects. The exclusions include English or Chinese language-related subjects, Critical Thinking, Extended Project Qualification, General Studies, Global Perspectives and Research, Knowledge and Enquiry, Project Work and Thinking Skills.

source.title: HKU 2027 international admissions, PDF p. 2, university-wide requirements

requirements.label: AP · general eligibility
requirements.details: Present at least three eligible AP subjects and either SAT or two further eligible AP subjects. The university may consider comparable ACT results. English Language and Composition, AP Research and AP Seminar are excluded. Programme-level grade and test conditions vary.

source.title: HKU 2027 international admissions, PDF p. 2, university-wide requirements

profiles.notes: 2028/29 non-JUPAS entry, per the faculty’s forward guidance.

requirements.label: AP · competitive reference for 2028/29
requirements.details: At least eight AP exams at grade 5, together with one of these test scores in a single sitting: SAT 1500/1600 or ACT composite 34. Check the faculty’s excluded AP subjects.

source.title: HKUMed Non-JUPAS FAQ, expected scores for 2028/29

requirements.label: A-level / International A-level · 2028/29 exam timing
requirements.details: All four required A-level subject grades must be obtained in the same examination series at the end of the two-year course. The 2027/28 exception for an earlier Mathematics examination ends for this cycle.
